summary: Testosterone is the main androgen in men and is also present at lower levels in women. It follows a daily rhythm and peaks in the morning, so the timing of the sample changes the result substantially.
what_it_measures: The total concentration of testosterone in blood, reported in nmol/L, ideally from a morning fasting sample.

interpretations.meaning: A low testosterone in men can cause reduced libido, fatigue and loss of muscle. A single low afternoon sample is not enough to act on and should be repeated in the morning.
A raised testosterone in women can cause acne, excess hair growth and irregular periods.

when_to_seek_help: Testosterone must be measured on a morning sample and confirmed on a second occasion before any treatment decision. Discuss results with your GP.
approved_by: Demo dataset (illustrative values, not for clinical use)
